source: Global Entity Directory.pdf (NotebookLLM summary). Verify against the original BRSR.

derived.energy_method: Disclosed total electricity in MJ divided by 3.6 MJ per kWh. Monthly split is an even 1/12 of the annual total.
derived.waste_method: Disclosed non-hazardous and e-waste tonnes converted to kg per month (annual / 12). Other waste categories are not in the calculator's factors and are omitted.

notes: Scope 1 includes 14,769 t of HFC refrigerant emissions, which the calculator has no factor for.
Scope 2 is compared on a location basis: the calculator applies one grid factor to all electricity.
